voluminös.et: Borrowed from French volumineux. By surface analysis, Volumen + -ös.

Volumen.et: Learned borrowing from Latin volūmen (“scroll”). The sense of "capacity" is derived from French volume.

Voluntourismus.et: Blend of Volunteering + Tourismus; possibly a calque of English voluntourism.
